lines.en: As many stars as there are in the sky,
so many pains I carry in my heart.
Cursed fate, what have you done to me,

lines.cyr: од верна љубов што ме раздели?
lines.lat: od verna ljubov što me razdeli?
lines.en: you who parted me from a faithful love?

lines.cyr: Еј, кај се тие слатки соништа,
lines.lat: Ej, kaj se tie slatki soništa,
lines.en: Hey, where are those sweet dreams,

lines.cyr: Еј, кај се сега тие насмевки,
lines.lat: Ej, kaj se sega tie nasmevki,
lines.en: Hey, where are those smiles now,
Cursed fate, what have you done to me,

lines.cyr: од верна љубов што ме раздели?
lines.lat: od verna ljubov što me razdeli?
lines.en: you who parted me from a faithful love?

lines.cyr: Еј, мои деној, црни без тебе,
lines.lat: Ej, moi denoj, crni bez tebe,
lines.en: Hey, my days, black without you,

lines.cyr: за мене славеј веќе не пее.
lines.lat: za mene slavej veḱe ne pee.
lines.en: for me the nightingale no longer sings.
I waited for a little happiness, it never came,
I spent my wretched youth in sorrow.
Cursed fate, what have you done to me,

lines.cyr: од верна љубов што ме раздели?
lines.lat: od verna ljubov što me razdeli?
lines.en: you who parted me from a faithful love?
